name: theharvester
title: theHarvester
description: theHarvester — OSINT email / subdomain / IP / employee harvesting from public sources (search engines, certificate transparency, code repos, breach archives, social platforms). Set THEHARVESTER_DOMAIN to the target organisation's apex domain; THEHARVESTER_SOURCES (CSV, e.g. 'anubis,crtsh,duckduckgo,hackertarget') restricts which providers are queried. THEHARVESTER_LIMIT caps results per source.
